title: the build keys read Rust source off the syntax tree `syn` parses, and the `card` tier leaves out a class's link to its card
scope:
how `bun nv`'s build keys and the perf ledger's `impl_hash` read a `.rs` file: which program reads it, and
what the `shipped` and `card` tiers leave out. It does not change which tier a check keys on, or what
the partitions are.
validatedBy: `tools/nv/test/keys.test.ts`, which also checks the scanner's card types against the registry's.
